mapper.sql: id, session_id, role, content, refs, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_message (session_id, role, content, refs) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{refs})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_chat_message WHERE role = 'ASSISTANT' AND create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS dayKey, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_chat_message WHERE role = 'ASSISTANT' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATE(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dayKey ASC
